scope: Repair post-00 / partial-01 governance drift before repository-wide redline work.

requirements.requirement: Operate only on existing kimi; no branch, PR, merge, rebase or force push.
requirements.failure: Any other branch or PR workflow is used.

requirements.requirement: Preserve Round 006 and Round 007 evidence byte-for-byte as historical scoped PASS.
requirements.failure: Historical Acceptance/PASS/evidence is edited or used to authorize current Step 2.

requirements.requirement: All active entrypoints state Step 1 IN_PROGRESS and Step 2-6 BLOCKED.
requirements.failure: Any live entrypoint says current Step 1 PASS or routes to 02 before a live seal.

requirements.requirement: MASTER_SPEC, PROJECT_STATUS, active addendum, policy and handover agree on 01 continuation.
Existing canonical registries are PRESEAL_DRAFT and may not authorize Step 2.
requirements.failure: An internal CANONICAL label bypasses the seal.

requirements.requirement: Missing closure/policy/seal files are marked PLANNED_NOT_CREATED or NOT_CREATED.
requirements.failure: A missing path is presented as an existing authority.

requirements.requirement: PR #8 is recorded as stale external non-authority without updating, closing or merging it.
requirements.failure: PR metadata is treated as current product authority or a prohibited PR operation occurs.

requirements.requirement: AI_PROJECT_POLICY source order follows user decision, Project source, active change control, seal, then lower canon.
requirements.failure: Unsealed MASTER_SPEC outranks active change control.

requirements.requirement: Runtime, assets, V1 candidate/schema/validator/simulator, backend, payment, ads and Production remain unchanged.
requirements.failure: Any forbidden path or external configuration changes.

requirements.requirement: Content commit is a direct descendant of baseHead and changes only declared documentation/status paths.
Vercel Preview is READY and tied to exact content commit/kimi; READY is not quality PASS.
requirements.failure: Deployment commit/branch mismatch or Production alias change.

requirements.requirement: Evidence commit directly follows content commit and records exact commit/tree/deployment/changed paths; checkpoint unresolved P0/P1=0.
requirements.failure: Evidence is not exact or any checkpoint P0/P1 remains.
